# Archify

Source: https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify
Revision: c6519401f7b91b9d43011657880893b0a8955548
License: MIT

The archify-edge-flow keyframes in archify/assets/template.html are adapted in app/edupi-motion.css. EduPi supplies its own student records and live session state. No Archify skill is installed and no student data is sent to Archify. The full diagram renderer is not bundled.
